senses.gloss:
(ई) यती r. 1st cl. (यतते)
1 To resolve or determine in consequence of a wish or desire, to apply or endeavour
2 strenuously, to energize, to persevere.
r. 10th cl. (यातयति)
1 To distress or afflict.
2 To beat.
3 To order.
4 To collect, to assemble.
5 To work, to make or manufacture.
6 To prevent, to remove.
7 To return, to give back, to requite.
8 To barter or exchange.
9 To purify.
With निर् or नि prefixed,
To chastise, to punish, to inflict pain.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Governed, controlled.
2 Limited, restrained.
E.
यम to check, क्त aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Striven, resolved, exerted.
E.
यत to resolve, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gone, went.
2 Obtained, got.
n. (-तं)
Driving or guiding an elephant with a goad.
E.
यत to endeavour, or या to go, aff. क्त.

ind.
Because, as, since, wherefore, correlative of तत् thence, therefore, &c.
E.
यम to check, to restrain, क्विप् and तुक् aff.

m. (-यान्-यान्ती-यात्)
Going.
E.
या to go, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Resigned, subdued, one of well-governed thoughts or feelings.
E.
यत, and चित्त the mind.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Having power over the soul and spirit, of subdued mind.
E.
यतचित्त, and आत्मन् self.

mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्)
Striving, making effort.
E.
यत to make effort, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Making effort or exertion.
E.
यत to make effort, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-ना)
1 Pain, agony, sharp or acute pain.
2 Pain or punishment inflicted by YAMA or his ministers, the pains of hell.
E.
यत to inflict pain, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be exerted or persevered, to be made as an effort.
E.
यत to make effort अनीयर्, aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Which, (of many.)
E.
यद् which, डतमच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Making effort, striving, struggling, persevering.
E.
यत to strive, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Disinclined to sexual intercourse, abstaining from it.
E.
यत, and मैथुन coition.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Which, (of two,) whether.
E.
यट् which, डतरच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Firm to an engagement or vow.
E.
यत, and व्रत a vow.

ind.
Because, as since, whence: see यत्.
E.
यद् which, what, and तसि substituted for the termination of the 5th case.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Of subdued or well-governed spirit.
E.
यत, and आत्मन् self.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Self-subdued, having the mind and all its powers in subjection.
E.
यतात्म, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Temperate, abstemious.
E.
यत, and आहार food.

m. (-तिः)
1 A sage, whose passions are completely under subjection.
2 A religious mendicant, especially one of the Jaina sect.
3 Stopping, ceasing, rest, term.
4 Restraining, controlling^1, checking.
f. (-तीः)
1 A pause in poetry or metre, a stop, a rest.
2 Union, joining.
3 Passion, sentiment.
4 A widow.
E.
यत to endeavour, &c., aff. इन्, or यम् to restrain, aff. क्तिन्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-ती)
A sage with subdued passions.
f. (-नी)
A widow.
E.
यत restraining, from यम with क्त aff., and इनि added.

n. (-त्रं)
A vessel for collecting alms, made of wood, or a hollow bambu, an earthen bowl, or a gourd.
E.
यति, and पात्र a vessel.

n. (-नं)
The copulation or cohabitation of holy personages.
E.
यति as above, and मैथुन coition.

f. (-का)
A plant, Cakāvat commonly.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Chaste, pure, of subdued passions.
E.
यत, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Doing what.
E.
यत्, and कृ to do, अच् aff.

m. (-त्नः)
Effort, exertion, perseverance, energy.
E.
यत to endeavour strenuously or continuously, aff. नङ्.

ind.
Vigorously, strenuously.
E.
यत्न, and तसि aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Persevering, diligent, making effort or exertion.
E.
यत्न effort, मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
To be exerted or made as an effort.
E.
यत to exert, यत् aff.

m. (-त्यः)
An infernal or condemned spirit.
E.
यत to endeavour, causal form, aff. यत्, to be made to toil.

ind.
Where, in what place.
E.
यद what, and त्रल् aff.

(इ) यत्रि r. 1st and 10th cls. (यन्त्रति यन्त्रयति)
To confine, to restrain, to subdue or regulate: the root may also be written यन्त्र.

f. (-त्रा)
1 Going, moving, proceeding, marching, travelling.
2 Passing away time.
3 Practice, usage, custom.
4 A holy festival, but especially the procession of idols, &c. which usually forms part of the ceremonies on such an occasion.
5 An expedient, a means.
6 The march of an assailing force.
7 Going to pilgrimage.
8 A sort of dramatic entertainment.
E.
या to go, Uṇādi aff. त्रन्.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Old.
2 Used, impaired.
3 Rejected, abandoned.
4 Raw, half ripe or dressed.
E.
यात gone or got, याम forbearance, relinquishment.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be gone.
2 To be gone against, to be attacked or invaded.
E.
या to go, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु)
A goer, one who goes or moves.
m. (-तुः)
A demon, a goblin, an imp or evil spirit.
m. (-तुः)
1 Time.
2 A traveller, a wayfarer.
E.
या to go, तु Uṇādi aff.

m. (-नः)
A goblin, an evil spirit.
E.
यातु the same, धा to have, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-ता)
1 A charioteer, a driver.
2 A husband's brother's wife.
E.
यत to endeavour assiduously, Uṇādi aff. ऋत्, and the radical vowel made long.

n. (-णं)
Setting forth on a journey, a march, &c.
E.
यात्रा, and करण making.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Performing a pilgrimage.
E.
यात्रा, and प्रसङ्ग engaging in.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Relating to a march, &c.
2 Customary, usual.
m. (-कः)
1 A pilgrim.
2 A traveller.
n. (-कं)
Provision, supplies, conveyance, &c. for a march.
E.
यात्रा, and ठक् aff.

m. (-वः)
A public festival.
E.
यात्रा procession, and उत्सव festival.
